## Before you ask for a review

- [ ] I merged the latest `main` into my branch  (`git fetch origin` and `git merge origin/main` or done the same in Visual Studio) and fixed any conflicts
- [ ] `npm run check` passes on my computer (lint, formatting, tests and build) for React projects
- [ ] I added or updated tests for what I changed
- [ ] I did not commit secrets (`.env.local`, API keys) or `node_modules`
